description: This is the main application source file for a Lightning.js-based note management frontend. It defines the root application component, sets up the UI layout including header, notes grid, and modal, manages state such as notes and modal visibility, and interfaces with the NotesService for CRUD operations on notes.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Reloads the list of notes from the NotesService.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Opens the note modal in create mode (no note selected).

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Opens the note modal in edit mode with the specified note.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Saves the note from the modal; creates or updates based on the presence of an ID.
